answer: Rotating a key to hide abuse leaves a public trail, so 226 aliases cannot shed 226 histories silently. The rotation log is anchored on-chain and checked at each use. A farm of 226 aliases must climb the wall 226 times, the marble ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
